name: 一週間の営業時間表
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0027 一週間の営業時間表, an expanded weekly opening-hours card. Input1 ORIGINAL Google Maps screenshot controls clock icon geometry, optical weight, expanded chevron direction, current-day emphasis, alignment and fine details; region x47 y935 width1081 height939. Input2 rough native mock is secondary Japanese content and overall table layout: its downward chevron is WRONG for the expanded state and all-green utility icons need coherent slate. Input3 approved bus is style only.
On pure white, one compact white rounded card, fine neutral border, restrained shadow. Header: original outlined clock glyph at left in slate #526173, circular dial with vertical-up hand and diagonal lower-right hand, then "営業中" in forest green #1F6444, then small UPWARD chevron in slate, indicating expanded state. Match original clock optical weight and original chevron construction, no decorative circle around chevron.
Under header, exactly seven rows in this order: "火曜日" "6:00〜22:00"; "水曜日" "6:00〜22:00"; "木曜日" "6:00〜22:00"; "金曜日" "6:00〜22:00"; "土曜日" "6:00〜22:00"; "日曜日" "6:00〜22:00"; "月曜日" "6:00〜22:00". Aligned weekday column and right time column. Tuesday is the CURRENT DAY, so subtly bold its label and time exactly as original; remaining days regular400. No colored highlight background or selected chip. Bottom text link "営業時間の修正を提案", aligned with the weekday labels.
Accent decision: original blue utility clock becomes coherent slate; original blue edit link becomes brand forest green because actionable text; operational 営業中 remains green from the Japanese saved adaptation. No random icon colors or broad mint fills. All seven times exact; no invented dates, current-time line, rows or buttons.
Use locked Meiryo Regular14/24 for rows, current Tuesday Bold14/24 for source emphasis, metadata/link12/16Regular,tracking0. Compact readable spacing, moderate padding, original indented table under header, ink #1D1D1D and secondary #6E6E6E. Flat frontal high-resolution portrait card around4:3 width-to-height, modest white canvas margins. No screen/device chrome, unrelated address/website rows or logos. Original reference has priority over rough mock for fine detail and visible state.
reviewNotes: Actual original/native/output review: original outlined clock anatomy and UP chevron restored; expanded state consistent. Seven Japanese rows Tuesday-to-Monday, all6:00〜22:00, current Tuesday label/time bold; other rows regular. Exact edit-link copy retained. Original blue utility icon adapted to coherent slate; status and actionable link forest green; no broad tinted fill. White rounded panel, column alignment, wrapping and legibility checked. Agent-reviewed raster candidate only, not owner approval/native editability/application behavior.
